ruleDefinitions.name: MSSQL Add Account To Sysadmin Role
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when an attacker tries to backdoor the MSSQL server by adding a backdoor account to the sysadmin fixed server role Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, Data

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = RGX(".*MSSQL.*") AND event_id = 33205 AND (Data = RGX(".*object\\_name\\:sysadmin.*") AND Data = RGX(".*statement\\:alter\\ server\\ role\\ \\[sysadmin\\]\\ add\\ member\\ .*")))
